title: Pull request CI checks and wall-clock duration
description: One element per pull request. Each element lists the GitHub check runs and commit statuses on that pull request's head SHA, plus the wall-clock span the cost model reads as cicd_seconds. Join to pr_token_usage_dataset.json on pr_number. A pull request missing from this array is treated as zero failed jobs, zero successful jobs, and zero CI seconds.

state.description: MERGED when merged_at is set. Otherwise the GitHub pull request state, uppercased.

author.description: user.login of the pull request author.

head_sha.description: head.sha. Check runs and statuses are read for this commit.

jobs.description: Check runs and commit statuses for head_sha. Both are included. Order is not significant.

summary.description: Counts are over jobs. SUCCESS, FAILURE, and CANCELLED each have their own counter. SKIPPED, NEUTRAL, and PENDING share skipped_or_neutral_count. Any other conclusion counts only toward total_jobs_count. overall_status is FAILURE when failed_jobs_count is greater than 0, and SUCCESS otherwise. total_cicd_duration_seconds is the rounded wall-clock span from the earliest started_at to the latest completed_at among jobs that have started_at. It is the span across jobs, and the sum of duration_seconds is a different number. The estimator reads failed_jobs_count, successful_jobs_count, and total_cicd_duration_seconds.

earliest_job_started_at.description: Minimum started_at. Null when no job has started_at.

latest_job_completed_at.description: Maximum completed_at among jobs that have started_at.

total_cicd_duration_seconds.description: Round((latest_job_completed_at - earliest_job_started_at) / 1000). Null when either endpoint is null. This is the value stored as cicdSeconds.

total_cicd_duration_formatted.description: Display form of total_cicd_duration_seconds: 37s, 6m 23s, or 1h 2m 3s. Seconds are always included.

pr_created_to_cicd_completed_seconds.description: Round((latest_job_completed_at - created_at) / 1000). Null when latest_job_completed_at is null.

time_to_merge_seconds.description: Round((merged_at - created_at) / 1000). Null when merged_at is null.

type.description: CheckRun is a check run on head_sha (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs). StatusContext is one entry of the combined commit status (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/status, field statuses).

name.description: Check run name, or the status context string.

workflow.description: For a check run whose details_url is https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/job/{job_id}, the name of that Actions workflow run. For any other check run, External / Unspecified. For a status context, Status Context.

status.description: Uppercased check-run status. Status contexts are recorded as COMPLETED.

conclusion.description: Uppercased check-run conclusion or status state. Observed values are SUCCESS, FAILURE, CANCELLED, SKIPPED, NEUTRAL, and PENDING. GitHub also uses TIMED_OUT, ACTION_REQUIRED, STALE, STARTUP_FAILURE, and ERROR.

started_at.description: Check run started_at. Null for a status context, which has no start time.

completed_at.description: Check run completed_at, or the status updated_at.

duration_seconds.description: Round((completed_at - started_at) / 1000) when both timestamps exist and the difference is zero or positive. Null when a timestamp is missing or the job completed before it started.

duration_formatted.description: Same display form as total_cicd_duration_formatted. Null when duration_seconds is null.

details_url.description: Check run details_url, or the status target_url.
